title: lint: ai-skill-tool-unresolved knows only action_<action>; action tools are action_<object>__<action> since #31515
body:
repo:cloud#3 · os-zhuang · session_01QUs3BvRcDHXqRU4TSVE4u6

Filing gate: **(c) a residual a landed card's review names**. #31515 (the condition attached to #30806 item 14, ruling A) is implemented in objectstack-ai/cloud PR #3846. An object-bound action's AI tool is now named `action_<object>__<action>` (e.g. `action_crm_lead__convert_lead`; names over 64 characters keep the first 48, then `_`, then 8 hex of FNV-1a32 of `<object>:<action>`). A top-level action keeps `action_<action>`. Cloud still resolves an old `action_<action>` claim to every action of that name, so nothing breaks today.
The gap is in this repo: `packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.ts:155` builds the tool universe as `action_<name>` and `:221` strips `'action_'`. A skill that claims the new qualified name therefore gets an `ai-skill-tool-unresolved` warning, and no author can move to the new spelling without one.
Dedup: searched open and closed issues for "ai-skill-tool-unresolved" and "validate-ai-tool-references"; only #31040 came up (closed, unrelated: delete_package).
Reader: the devx lane (packages/lint). Serial: after cloud#3846 lands (`pm:blocked` until then).

## 维护者速读

AI 动作工具名已改为带对象名（`action_<对象>__<动作>`，云端 PR #3846）。框架 lint 只认旧拼法，技能里写新名字会被误报「工具不存在」。需要把拼法放进 spec 让 lint 与云端共用一份。不影响运行。

## Work

1. Put the spelling in spec, as ONE exported helper (e.g. `actionToolName({ name, objectName? })` plus the legacy reader), byte-identical to cloud's `packages/service-ai/src/tools/action-tool-name.ts` (charset `[a-z0-9_]`, max 64, the FNV-1a32 shortening rule). Pin vectors shared with cloud's `action-tool-name.test.ts`.
2. The lint universe holds the qualified name of each object-bound exposed action AND keeps accepting the old `action_<action>` spelling, which cloud still resolves. The unexposed-action hint (`:221`) works for both spellings.
3. Pins: a qualified claim resolves; an old claim resolves; a claim naming an action on the wrong object is reported. CONTROL: a top-level action's claim is unchanged.
4. Once spec ships it, cloud can import the helper instead of its own copy. That's a cloud follow-up, noted on the PR.

Priority: p3.
